existing.description: The Monash International Leadership Scholarship is a merit-based award for international students who have received a full, unconditional Monash course offer and will enrol full-time in an undergraduate degree at an Australian Monash campus. Recipients receive 100% of their course fees until the minimum number of points for their degree are completed, with OSHC, accommodation and living costs excluded. There is no separate application: every student who holds an unconditional undergraduate offer is considered automatically, and four scholarships are awarded each year. Recipients must maintain a Weighted Average Mark of 70 each semester to retain the award.
eligibility: International student (not Australian citizen or permanent resident).
Received a full, unconditional undergraduate course offer from Monash University.
Intends to enrol full-time in a bachelor's degree at a Monash campus in Australia.
